detail.longDescription: Chat alone can't run your business. Your AI tool can draft a reply, summarize a call, or sort a spreadsheet, but the work happens once, and only while you're watching. The next time, you have to ask again. Zaps fix that. Your agent builds it, and Zapier keeps it running. Describe what you want, and your agent turns it into a Zap, an automated workflow that deploys to Zapier and starts on its own: on a schedule (cron), on a webhook, or the moment something happens in one of your apps, like a new
